about_the_game:
Thank you from all of us at the Noble Legacy team for your support during our Early Access Launch period.

Heather is now available as a unique character you may encounter and recruit into your village for a limited time. She blends naturally into your recruitment pool, offering a unique personality and depth in shaping your Kingdoms Story!

Introducing Heather.

Born to Highland traders, Heather learned the art of brewing from monastery monks during harsh winters spent sheltering in abbeys. When Norman lords seized her family's lands, she fled south with nothing but her knowledge of ales and spirits. Earning coin through her craft in roadside inns, she perfected recipes that could lift weary hearts and loosen stubborn tongues. Heather brings her brewing expertise, keen ear for gossip, and warm Highland hospitality to your settlement, while her quick wit and fondness for sharing a dram with patrons make her as beloved as she is skilled. She won’t guarantee success and she won't promise sobriety—but she might just make your village's nights far more spirited.

Traits & Personality

Emotional: Leader

Behavior: Wanderer

Role: Tradsmen

Heather will be added to your recruitment pool and can be recruited as other villagers can. Keep an eye out.

short_description: Noble Legacy is a medieval city building game from a 3rd person perspective. With the depth of city building simulation games and the immersiveness of 3rd person RPGs, Noble Legacy will deliver on the power fantasy to “Be the ruler of a medieval kingdom.”
